summary: All 13 source files matched their recorded hashes and sizes, and all nine computations reproduced. The evidence identifies HT125IBM (GSM6062950) as the excluded pig. All 43 comparable S4 effects agree in direction. Two registered genes meet the paper’s rule, HROB and MIR150-1, and only HROB appears in S4. The corrected proposal retains the selected-results closure of `compared` and keeps the detailed review `unresolved`. It passed the repository proposal validator.
openIssues: S7 marks GRPEL2 and UQCRC2 significant although both are absent from S4. It leaves TBCD unmarked despite an S4 adjusted P of 2.48e-7. [S4 pooled results](https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article/file?type=supplementary&id=10.1371/journal.pone.0272775.s005) · [S7 validation table](https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article/file?type=supplementary&id=10.1371/journal.pone.0272775.s008)
Eight S4 genes lack public registered effects. Coverage is 43/51 (84.31%), below the 90% concordance requirement, and the registered cohort includes the excluded animal.

The 19-animal genotype-only DESeq2 replay recovered 49 of 51 S4 calls. CNOT8 and WFIKKN1 crossed the adjusted-P threshold in the replay. The original design, filtering settings, package version and all-tested table remain unavailable.
